name: Indian Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 6 small potatoes, peeled and cut in half

steps: Sauté the garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes, until the oil and tomatoes separate (they will bubble).
Add ½ tsp red pepper, and salt to taste. Boil it all together.
Add the potatoes. Cook over low-medium heat until the potatoes are done. They will become fairly soft; check with a fork.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
